XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: OBD warning light comes on, "Check emissions system" warning appears on display
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: 77714 | INJECTION | PROBE | LAMBDA | MOUNT | CATALYST | MIL | WARNING LIGHTS | FAULT | 013021 | NOX | OXYGEN | GAS | EXHAUST | SERVICE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Euro 6D cars manufactured between 01/01/17 and 31/12/22

  • System: Injection

  • Device: Lambda probe upstream of the catalytic converter

  • Fault: OBD warning light comes on, "Check emission control system" warning on the display

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: 013021

  • Cause: Lambda probe upstream of the catalytic converter dirty or faulty

• Action: Clean or, if necessary, replace the upstream lambda probe

  • Procedure: Remove the upstream lambda sensor and clean the part of the sensor that comes into contact with the exhaust gases using compressed air.
    Reinstall the upstream lambda sensor, clear the diagnostic errors and perform a road test.
    If the fault reappears accompanied by error code 013021, replace the upstream lambda sensor.

  • Note: At the end of the operation, reprogram the injection control unit if necessary.
